sections.title: Special attack mechanics
lines: Improved Grab (Ex) · After hitting with Bite, start a grapple as a free action against a smaller target without provoking an attack of opportunity. Win the grapple check to pull the target into the snake’s space. It can hold using only its mouth at a −20 grapple penalty and avoid taking the grappled penalties.

sections.title: Trait mechanics

Swim · The listed modifier includes the +8 racial bonus for hazards or special maneuvers. Take 10 even when threatened or distracted. It can run while swimming in a straight line.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Always neutral. Organization as printed: Solitary.
Feats: Alertness, Endurance, Skill Focus (Hide), Toughness.

Endurance grants +4 on endurance and exposure checks and saves, including Swim to resist nonlethal damage and Constitution checks for continuing to run, forced marches, holding breath, and avoiding starvation or thirst.

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A great white-like shark that can exceed 20 feet in length. It has a heavy body, dark gray back, white underside, a tall triangular dorsal fin and a crescent-shaped tail.

sections.title: Attack options
lines: Space 15 ft. and reach 10 ft. Both the attack and full attack are a single Bite.

lines: Bite · melee · +10 to hit · reach 10 ft. · 2d6+7

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Blindsense (Ex) · While underwater, the shark can locate creatures underwater within 30 ft. Blindsense alone does not remove concealment.
Keen Scent (Ex) · The shark detects creatures by scent within 180 ft. and blood in the water up to 1 mile away.
Aquatic subtype · The shark breathes water and cannot breathe air. Ordinary swimming takes no Swim check.

Swim · The listed +13 includes a +8 racial bonus on Swim checks for hazards and special maneuvers. The shark can take 10 even under threat or distraction and can run while swimming in a straight line.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Feats are Alertness, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative and Iron Will.
Use Will +4 for this SRD printing. The original RTF, and linked HTML reprint give +4. The d20srd.org reprint lists +6, which matches the result of applying Iron Will's +2 bonus.
Organization is solitary, a school of 2–5, or a pack of 6–11. Advancement is 11–17 HD (Huge). The source gives no level adjustment.
The shark circles potential prey before darting in to bite.

sections.title: Feat mechanics
lines: Flyby Attack · While flying, take a standard action at any point during one move. The roc cannot take a second move action that round.

Snatch · On a talon or bite hit, the roc can start a grapple as with Improved Grab. Against a target three or more sizes smaller, it deals automatic damage from the grabbing weapon each round. It can drop the target as a free action or fling it 1d6 × 10 ft. as a standard action. Fling damage is 1d6 per 10 ft. traveled, or falling damage if greater while airborne.
Wingover · Once per round while flying, spend 10 ft. of movement to turn up to 180 degrees as a free action. It may dive during a wingover but cannot gain altitude that round.

lines: The portrait shows a gray-brown viper with broad dark saddles, a dark eye stripe and pale scales along the lower jaw.

sections.title: Attack options
lines: Space 5 ft. and reach 5 ft. Both the attack and full attack are one Bite with injury poison.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · melee · +4 to hit · reach 5 ft. · 1d2−2 piercing, slashing and bludgeoning

sections.title: Special attack mechanics
lines: Poison (Ex) · After a damaging bite, the target makes a Fortitude save immediately and again 1 minute later, even if the first save succeeds. Each failure deals 1d6 Constitution damage. The viper is immune to its own venom and to venom from others of its kind. · DC 10 Fortitude

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Scent (Ex) · Detect creatures by smell within 30 ft., 60 ft. if the creature is upwind or 15 ft. if downwind. A move action reveals the direction. Within 5 ft., the viper can pinpoint the creature.

Snake skills · The listed modifiers include racial bonuses of +4 to Hide, Listen and Spot and +8 to Balance and Climb. Use the higher of Strength and Dexterity for Climb. The viper can take 10 on Climb checks even when rushed or threatened.
Swim · The listed Swim modifier includes a +8 racial bonus for hazards and special maneuvers. The viper can take 10 even when distracted or in danger, and can run in a straight line while swimming.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Always neutral. Solitary. The SRD lists no advancement or level adjustment. The viper usually bites defensively and then retreats.
Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity on the Bite attack roll. The listed attack bonus already uses Dexterity.

Use initiative +3 and the listed Weapon Finesse feat for this SRD printing. The later Monster Manual errata makes Weapon Finesse a bonus feat and adds Improved Initiative. d20srd.org reflects those changes and gives initiative +7.
Roll the printed Bite damage. If the result is below 1, the hit deals 1 damage before applying defenses.

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A small, squat amphibian with mottled, bumpy skin and broad-set eyes.

sections.title: Attack options
lines: Space 1 ft. and reach 0 ft. No attack or full attack is listed.

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Amphibious · The toad can breathe air and water. Its stat block gives a 5 ft. land speed and no swim speed.
Camouflage · Its coloration gives the included +4 racial bonus to Hide.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Always neutral. Organization as printed: Swarm (10–100).
Swarm is its organization in the table. A single toad uses the Animal type and has no listed attack.

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A slender, short-legged mammal with a long flexible body, rounded ears and a pale throat. The same stats can describe a ferret.

sections.title: Attack options
lines: Space 2-1/2 ft. and reach 0 ft. Attack and full attack each use one Bite attack.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · melee · +4 to hit · 1d3-4 piercing, slashing and bludgeoning

sections.title: Special attack mechanics
lines: Attach (Ex) · A successful Bite lets the weasel attach. It deals Bite damage automatically each round it remains attached. AC drops to 12. It can be struck or grappled. A grappler must pin it to remove it.

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Scent (Ex) · Detect creatures by smell within 30 ft., 60 ft. if upwind or 15 ft. if downwind. Use a move action to find the direction. Pinpoint the creature within 5 ft.
Weasel skills · Includes +4 racial to Move Silently and +8 racial to Balance and Climb. Use Dexterity for Climb and take 10 even when rushed or threatened.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Always neutral. Organization as printed: Solitary.
Monster Manual errata grants Agile and makes Weapon Finesse a bonus feat. It gives Balance +12 and Escape Artist +4. Use the original SRD values for this printing.
A hit whose printed damage roll falls below 1 deals a minimum of 1 damage before defenses.
With 0 ft. of reach, it must enter the target’s space to make its melee attack.
